description: The plot illustrates the Accuracy@1 (%) for two different models, GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet, across varying numbers of child nodes. The x-axis is labeled "Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)" and features a linear scale ranging from 1 to 7, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 15 to 35, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The line representing GPT-4o is a solid blue line with circular markers. It begins at a value of 24.4 at x=1, increases to 28.9 at x=3, reaches a peak at x=5 (where the exact numerical label is obscured by a grey rectangle), and then declines to end at 31.1 at x=7. The line representing Claude-3.5-Sonnet is a solid light blue line with 'x' markers. It starts at 26.7 at x=1, rises slightly to a peak of 27.8 at x=3, decreases to 24.4 at x=5, and continues to decline, ending at 20.0 at x=7.
